title: S. Korea's Lee to attend Asean, Apec summits in Philippines, China
summary: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung will attend summits of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations and the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation next week, his national security adviser said…

blocks.text: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung will attend summits of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations and the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation next week, his national security adviser said Thursday. The South Korean president will depart Monday first for Manila where he will attend the ASEAN summit until Tuesday, followed by a two-day trip to China’s Shenzhen beginning Wednesday, where he will attend the APEC summit, National Security Adviser Wi Sung-lac told a briefing.
